name: Tox Brewing Company
notes: Menu transcribed item by item from the restaurant's own website; prices and descriptions as printed. Address from website. Phone from website. Hours not listed online.

sections.name: Beer
items: Sample any four 4-oz pours ONE at a time with tokens and KEEP the beaker as a souvenir!
IPA - Imperial, 8.5%, 12oz. Double Apparition is a scaled up version of our Pink/Mosaic Apparition IPA with a kiss of Citra.
IPA - New Zealand, 7.5%, 12oz. New Zealand hopped IPA w/ our estate Chardonnay grape juice
Pale Ale - American, 5.8%, 16oz. Pollen showcases a single hop and this version features Dolcita hops.
Wheat Beer - Dunkelweizen, 4.9%, 16oz Draft. Fruity and spicy flavors of a Hef with the rich, roasted character of dark malts.
IPA - Triple New England, 10%, 12oz. Triple IPA with Galaxy, Citra, Nelson Sauvin, and Mosaic.
IPA - American, 6%, 12oz. Slighlty less Abv, Citra, Simcoe, and Chinook. Citrus and Pine for days!
Stout - Imperial, 8%, 12oz. Imperial Stout Brewed with Ancho Chile Peppers and conditioned on Cacao Nibs, Vanilla, and Cinnamon.
IPA - American, 7%, 12oz. Amanita is our Mosaic forward IPA that also features Cascade hops.
IPA - American, 6.8%, 12oz. Experiment w/ thiol Suava Ale Yeast DH of Pink, Nelson Sauvin, and Citra.
Stout - Irish Dry, 4.5%, 16oz. Irish style dry stout. Roasty, dry, and just light enough.
Bitter - Extra Special, 5.9%, 16oz. This Extra Special Bitter Ale is our take on a classic English style beer.

items: 12 oz. Extra Dark, Lite, IPA, Golden Ale, Belgian Wit, Oktoberfest, Tropical Sour or Moscow Mule
